content:
Amazon is going all out on the early Black Friday LEGO deals this year. On its official Amazon page, you can get the LEGO Star Wars Mandalorian's N-1 Starfighter set (#75325) for $41.99, nearly $20 off of its original $59.99 sticker price. This is a pretty good deal on a great set on its own, but what makes this discount even more special is that the N-1 Starfighter set was officially retired in July this year. It's not entirely uncommon for Amazon to maintain stock of retired LEGO sets, but this popular set may be your last chance to grab one at a lower price before the value increases.

The 412-piece build is a faithful recreation of the Mandalorian's repurposed Naboo starfighter we see in the earlier episodes of the Disney+ series. This build specifically is from The Book of Boba Fett, where Din Djarin has it restored after losing his prized Razorcrest. It was some cool interactive elements, like a cockpit that opens and fireable lasers. It also includes four minifigures: the Mandalorian, the mechanic Peli Motto, Grogu, as well as a BD droid. These are also detailed versions of the onscreen counterparts, but the Grogu and BD droid figures are smaller single-brick pieces instead of fully buildable minifigures.

The final build measures in at 16.5in. long, 11.5in. wide, and 2.5in. tall, so you might need some space to display with the rest of your collection, and it makes a great gift for any Star Wars fan to pick up in time for the winter holidays and before it's gone for good.

If you're looking for more discounts in general, take a look at IGN's guide to the Amazon Black Friday sale. We break down everything you need to know.
